notes.content:
User: Note that I studied for 3 hours on Monday, 4 hours on Tuesday, and 2.5 hours on Wednesday for my exam.
Assistant: Got it — you studied 3 hours Monday, 4 hours Tuesday, and 2.5 hours Wednesday.

What would you like me to do with this info?
- Draft or send an email (to whom? professor, TA, study partner?) — I can compose and send it or save as a draft.
- Save as a note/draft summary in your drafts folder.
- Create a short progress summary you can copy elsewhere.
- Anything else?

If you want an email, here are two quick templates. Tell me which one to send (and the recipient email) or ask me to save as a draft.

1) Short, formal (for professor/TA)
Subject: Study hours for exam preparation
Body:
Hi [Name],
Just sharing my study hours for the exam this week:
- Monday: 3 hours
- Tuesday: 4 hours
- Wednesday: 2.5 hours
Please let me know if you need any further details.
Thanks,
[Your Name]

2) Brief, casual (for study partner)
Subject: My study hours this week
Body:
Hey — I studied:
- Mon: 3h
- Tue: 4h
- Wed: 2.5h
Feels like decent progress — how are you doing?

Which option and what should I do next? (Send now — include recipient email — or save as draft?)
